# FinQA smoke fixture

This directory contains three deterministic records from the `dev` split of the upstream [FinQA repository](https://github.com/czyssrs/FinQA):

- pinned revision: `0f16e2867befa6840783e58be38c9efb9229d742`;
- source file: `dev.json`;
- selected IDs and SHA-256 values: [`MANIFEST.json`](MANIFEST.json).

The fixture is test data, not an original work of DSH Surge Mode. The upstream snapshot used for this fixture did not expose a standard SPDX license declaration in the metadata inspected. `license_status` is therefore explicitly recorded as `upstream-license-not-identified`; do not assume the project MIT license covers these records. Confirm upstream terms before redistributing or using the fixture outside local testing.

Attribution: Chen et al., “FinQA: A Dataset of Numerical Reasoning over Financial Data”, EMNLP 2021. See [`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`](../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
